title: Philippines emerges as key driver of global tourism growth – WEF
summary: MANILA – The Philippines has emerged among major developing tourism economies recording faster growth in travel and tourism than the global average, according to a World Economic Forum report…

blocks.text: MANILA – The Philippines has emerged among major developing tourism economies recording faster growth in travel and tourism than the global average, according to a World Economic Forum report released Friday. The 2026 Travel and Tourism Development Index (TTDI) report identified the Philippines alongside China, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Turkiye, Mexico and Brazil as the 10 largest non-high-income travel and tourism economies driving significant global momentum. Together, these 10 countries account for over 28 percent of global direct travel and tourism gross domestic product, a share projected to rise to 35 percent by 2035.
